config.recovery_definition: first hourly time at or after pulse end with both stage backlogs and estimated outstanding service hours no greater than their t=4h pre-pulse values for three consecutive observations; no recovery by H+D is censored as not recovered

operational_region_definition.normal_or_capacity_edge: rho_high <= 1.00; no positive fluid overload debt B
operational_region_definition.congestion_operational: rho_high > 1.00 and Gamma < 1; recovery surplus can absorb fluid overload debt within the fixed 20h recovery window
operational_region_definition.congestion_severe: Gamma >= 1; fluid overload debt equals or exceeds all normal-rate recovery surplus

notes: 20 initial paired seeds for all 30 main cells; an additional 40 seeds are allocated, before reading comparative outcomes, to the six cells with 0.67 <= Gamma <= 1.33 nearest the physical overload/recovery frontier.
Main-profile admission horizon equals 4h pre-pulse + pulse duration + fixed 20h post-pulse recovery. Drain is fixed at 24h; all terminal deadlines (maximum 12h) mature before H+D.
Demand is synthetic Poisson by segment. HLS-B, D1 and P1 are not modified. No confirmatory claim is intended.

SLA and staffing sensitivity uses the five previously published SLA parameterizations and fixed demand for staffing changes, with base-demand traces reused where compatible; these conditional results are not pooled as operating probabilities.

trace_matching: all policies share identical synthetic alert object and trace hash per profile/seed/condition
